name: Ordinary Face Wash with Alpha Arbutin | Hydrating Cleanser for All Skin Types (100ml)
description:
Cleanse and refresh your skin with The Ordinary Face Wash with Alpha Arbutin (100ml) — a hydrating and soothing cleanser designed for all skin types. This gentle formula effectively removes dirt, oil, and impurities without drying or irritating the skin.

Enriched with Alpha Arbutin, it helps brighten and even out your complexion while maintaining the skin’s natural moisture balance. Perfect for daily use, it leaves your skin feeling clean, smooth, and naturally radiant after every wash.

Key Features:
Gentle daily cleanser suitable for all skin types
Hydrating and non-drying formula
Enriched with Alpha Arbutin for brightening and tone correction
Removes dirt, oil, and makeup without stripping natural moisture
Ideal for daily skincare routine

How to Use:
1⃣ Wet your face with lukewarm water.
2⃣ Apply a small amount of cleanser and massage gently in circular motions.
3⃣ Rinse thoroughly and pat dry.
4⃣ Use twice daily for best results.
